global_disjointness.allocation_order: EV-A first, then EV-B from remaining unique bases, then EV-C from remaining unique bases

source_domain_transport.graph: source -> source-family nodes with exact stage source capacities -> D1-D8 domain nodes through available source-domain capacity edges -> sink with exact domain targets
source_domain_transport.determinism: lexicographic source/domain edge insertion plus stage seed only for deterministic case ordering inside a feasible source-domain cell
source_domain_transport.failure: block before Candidate-v13 execution; do not weaken domain totals or source shares

family_b_matching.method: deterministic integer max-flow/b-matching over source-domain cells, unique base cases, and N1-N12 family nodes
family_b_matching.graph: root -> source-domain cell quota -> unique case nodes (capacity 1) -> each eligible family -> sink exact family target
family_b_matching.success_condition: flow equals exact stage total and all source-domain quotas/family targets are saturated
family_b_matching.case_uniqueness: one base case receives one primary structural family per stage
family_b_matching.failure: block before Candidate-v13 execution; do not change N-family totals

no_evidence_assignment.N10: all primary-family N10 cases are no-evidence by withholding every source-native gold memory
no_evidence_assignment.additional_no_evidence: fill remaining stage no-evidence quota by SHA256(stage_seed || base_item_id) ordering among already selected non-N10 cases
no_evidence_assignment.private_gold_retention: evaluator retains original source-native gold IDs only for false-retrieval scoring; Candidate-v13 never sees them

ev_c_stress.goal: EV-C must be measurably more heterogeneous/stress-heavy than EV-B without changing exact domain/source/family marginals
ev_c_stress.selection_rule: Within otherwise feasible source-domain/family candidate choices, EV-B tie-breaks toward lower stress_count and EV-C tie-breaks toward higher stress_count. This ordering is locked before Candidate-v13 external execution and never uses model outputs.
ev_c_stress.applicability: For each dimension with at least 100 eligible remaining EV-C reserve bases, selected EV-C proportion must exceed selected EV-B proportion by >=0.01.
ev_c_stress.failure: evaluation-design blocker before formal freeze; thresholds and family/domain totals cannot be relaxed

before_formal_freeze_must_not_persist: gold IDs linked to formal cases
